title: Hearty Salted Australian Oreo Cream Biscuits Lasagna
description: A comforting and savory Australian dish featuring Oreo cream biscuits, perfect for a diabetic-friendly meal. This recipe is en-croute and served in a salt block.
instructions: Brown the ground beef in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the paprika, garlic powder, thyme, salt, and pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the tomato paste and beef broth to the skillet and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and let cook for 5 minutes.
In a separate bowl, mix together the Greek yogurt and mozzarella cheese.
In a large baking dish, create a layer of the yogurt-cheese mixture.
Arrange 4-6 Oreo cream biscuits on top of the yogurt-cheese layer.
Repeat the layers two more times, ending with a layer of yogurt-cheese on top.
Transfer the dish to the preheated oven and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the dish from the oven and top with Parmesan cheese.
Serve the lasagna hot, garnished with additional thyme if desired.
Let the lasagna rest for 10 minutes before serving.
Slice the lasagna into 8 equal servings.
Note: This recipe is best served in a salt block for an authentic Australian experience.
